person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: six published sets of AI ethics principles, read together as one body
span.quote: But rather than generating yet another series of principles to serve as an ethical foundation for our recommendations, we offer a synthesis of existing sets of principles produced by various reputable, multi-stakeholder organisations and initiatives.

span.label: whether the four classic bioethics principles are sufficient for AI, and what a synthesis of existing principle sets yields
span.quote: The four bioethical principles adapt surprisingly well to the fresh ethical challenges posed by artificial intelligence. But they are not exhaustive.

span.label: a five-principle framework - the four bioethics principles plus explicability - claimed to capture all 47 principles in the six documents
span.quote: Taken together, we argue that these five principles capture the meaning of each of the 47 principles contained in the six high-profile, expert-driven documents, forming an ethical framework within which we offer our recommendations below.

span.label: critique
span.quote: The four bioethical principles adapt surprisingly well to the fresh ethical challenges posed by artificial intelligence. But they are not exhaustive.

span.label: the proliferation of separate AI ethics principle sets and their convergence
span.quote: Taken together, they yield 47 principles.

span.label: comparative synthesis of existing principle documents against the bioethics four
span.term: comparative synthesis of existing principle documents against the bioethics four
span.quote: But rather than generating yet another series of principles to serve as an ethical foundation for our recommendations, we offer a synthesis of existing sets of principles produced by various reputable, multi-stakeholder organisations and initiatives.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE DUAL ADVANTAGE: ethics pays twice - once by identifying opportunities that are socially acceptable, and once by heading off courses of action that are legal but socially rejected
span.quote: Adopting an ethical approach to AI confers what we define here as a “dual advantage”. On one side, ethics enables organisations to take advantage of the social value that AI enables. This is the advantage of being able to identify and leverage new opportunities that are socially acceptable or preferable. On the other side, ethics enables organisations to anticipate and avoid or at least minimise costly mistakes. This is the advantage of prevention and mitigation of courses of action that turn out to be socially unacceptable and hence rejected, even when legally unquestionable.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: META-AUTONOMY, a decide-to-delegate model: humans keep the power to decide WHICH decisions to take, and any delegation stays overridable
span.note: about this quote: the quote carries a line-break scar: the paper's “decide-to-delegate” is staged as “decide-todelegate”. The quote is verbatim against the staged text and the damaged form is NOT used as a term.
span.quote: Therefore, what seems most important here is what we might call “meta-autonomy”, or a “decide-todelegate” model: humans should always retain the power to decide which decisions to take, exercising the freedom to choose where necessary, and ceding it in cases where overriding reasons, such as efficacy, may outweigh the loss of control over decision-making.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE BLACK-BOX MENTALITY as a cause of lost responsibility: a system treated as beyond human understanding is treated as beyond human control
span.quote: This may happen not just because we have the wrong socio-political framework, but also because of a “black box” mentality, according to which AI systems for decision-making are seen as being beyond human understanding, and hence control.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: DESKILLING AS A SOCIETAL RISK: losing a skill in a domain where AI usually performs it leaves no fallback when the AI fails or is attacked - named for health-care diagnosis and aviation
span.quote: Furthermore, at the level of society, the deskilling in sensitive, skill-intensive domains, such as health care diagnosis or aviation, may create dangerous vulnerabilities in the event of AI malfunction or an adversarial attack.

span.label: The four bioethics principles are stated to be INSUFFICIENT for AI, which is the paper's own reason for adding a fifth
span.quote: The four bioethical principles adapt surprisingly well to the fresh ethical challenges posed by artificial intelligence. But they are not exhaustive.

span.label: Non-maleficence is left ambiguous between the developers and the technology - the paper names the ambiguity rather than resolving it
span.quote: From these various warnings, it is not entirely clear whether it is the people developing AI, or the technology itself, which should be encouraged not to do harm—in other words, whether it is Frankenstein or his monster against whose maleficence we should be guarding.

span.label: The framework is explicitly a EUROPEAN approach, offered as complementary to others rather than universal
span.quote: Different cultural frameworks inform attitudes to new technology. This document represents a European approach, which is meant to be complementary to other approaches.

span.label: Five of the Asilomar principles were EXCLUDED from the synthesis, so the 47 counted are not all the principles the six documents contain
span.quote: We have omitted consideration of the five “research issues” here as they are related specifically to the practicalities of AI development, particularly in the narrower context of academia and industry.

span.label: One of the six source documents was in redrafting when it was read, so the synthesis is tied to a version rather than to the document
span.quote: The Montreal Declaration is currently open for comments as part of a redrafting exercise. The principles we refer to here are those which were publicly announced as of 1st May, 2018.
